stem.text: What is the main reaction occurring in blood capillaries at the gas exchange surface in a human lung?

A.text: Carbonic acid dissociates into carbon dioxide and hydrogen ions.

B.text: Carbonic anhydrase converts carbon dioxide into hydrogencarbonate ions.

C.text: Carbon dioxide combines with haemoglobin to form carbaminohaemoglobin.

D.text: Carbon dioxide is produced from hydrogencarbonate ions by carbonic anhydrase.
